sections.heading: Account record validation
sections.text: Before advancing a CRM workflow, confirm that the account record contains the required account identifier, current owner, permitted contact attributes, and workflow status. If a required field is missing, do not invent or infer the value; route the record through the approved correction process.

sections.heading: Workflow escalation
sections.text: Escalate a CRM workflow issue when the record cannot be corrected using the documented user steps, when ownership is disputed, or when the requested action exceeds the user's role permissions.
